themes.name: Push notifications
themes.description: Breaking-news alerts and pop-ups, including whether they can be turned off or dismissed, how often they arrive, how they look and sound, and settings that control them.

themes.name: Live stream connectivity
themes.description: Whether live radio streams and local stations connect and keep playing, including endless connecting or spinning, "unable to play media" or "no audio available" errors, and dropped streams when switching networks or locking the phone.

themes.name: Buffering and playback interruptions
themes.description: Buffering, stalling, skipping, cutting out partway, jumping back or forward, and stories or podcasts that stop or start in the wrong place during on-demand playback.

themes.name: Playlist and queue
themes.description: Saving, managing and playing stories or podcasts in the playlist or queue, including playlists being erased, ordering, auto-advancing, and loading more items.

themes.name: App crashes and freezes
themes.description: The app crashing, force closing, freezing or locking up the phone, including crashes when opening images or on specific devices and Android versions.

themes.name: Background activity and battery
themes.description: The app running or starting by itself in the background, resuming playback unprompted, being unable to be closed, and its use of battery, memory and resources.

themes.name: Interface design
themes.description: Visual look, layout, navigation and menus, including outdated design, Material Design requests, font size, and ease of finding things in the app.

themes.name: Landscape and tablet support
themes.description: Support for landscape orientation and use on tablets, including forced portrait mode.

themes.name: Offline and downloads
themes.description: Ability to download programs, podcasts or articles for offline listening or reading, and data usage concerns when streaming.

themes.name: Advertisements
themes.description: Banner, pop-up and audio sponsorship ads, including ads that cannot be closed or that cover article text.

themes.name: Chromecast support
themes.description: Requests for or comments about casting audio to Chromecast or Google Cast devices.

themes.name: Political bias
themes.description: Perceptions of NPR's editorial slant, fairness, trustworthiness and political coverage, whether seen as balanced or biased.

themes.name: Station and program availability
themes.description: Whether specific local stations, shows, podcasts or archives of past episodes can be found in the app, including missing programs and the stations-nearby feature.

themes.name: Content freshness and article features
themes.description: How current the stories and shows are, along with article-reading features like sharing, comments, images and videos, and article text display.
